youtube.title: Michael Faraday's savage reply to a politician about electricity ⚡ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Michael Faraday showed a politician electricity. The politician asked "but what's the use?" ⚡🧾

Faraday found the one answer a finance minister understands.

What would you have said? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the famous (probably embellished) story: when Chancellor William Gladstone asked what use electricity was, Faraday replied "Why, sir, there is every probability that you will soon be able to tax it."

#michaelfaraday #electricity #historyofelectricity #historyofscience #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
